trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Tumkur, O.S No.17/2013
case_name: Smt. Rathnamma vs Sri. Krishnamurthy @ Mariyappa
facts_of_case: Appellant No. 1 claims she is the legally wedded wife of respondent having married him about 25 years ago. After marriage, she came to know respondent was already having a wife and children. Appellant No. 1 was harassed physically and mentally by respondent, who also made an attempt to kill her. She gave birth to appellant No. 2 and started residing with her parents.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party who alleges a fact to prove it.
legal_principles.held: The appellants have failed to prove the relationship with the respondent.
cited_cases: Yamunabai Anatrao Adhav Vs. Anantrao Shivram Adhav and another, 1988 (1) SCC

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to place reliance on evidence does not necessarily lead to adverse inference.
legal_principles.held: The trial Court has not drawn any adverse inference of the opposition made by the respondent for the DNA test.
cited_cases: Yamunabai Anatrao Adhav Vs. Anantrao Shivram Adhav and another, 1988 (1) SCC

outcome.final_order: The judgment and decree dated 29.09.2015 passed by the Principal Judge, Family Court, Tumkur, dismissing O.S No.17/2013 is set aside.

use_for_drafting: assisting with maintenance and custody matters
